DESCRIPTION_KR: TASTING NOTES; Aroma; Deep purple  in colour, the nose shows intense aromas of ripe cherry and blueberry, with hint of vibrant red fruits and cedary spice.; Palate; Rich and full flavoured yet elegant, a powerful wine without being excessively weighty. The palate is framed by supple tannins leading into luscious red fruits and elegant finish.; This wine will be enjoyed for many years to come.; VINEYARDS; Catkin is blended from four parcels of wine, each from a unique micro-climatic region of McLaren Vale. The first from Whites Valley producing wines with textural tannins and great flavour depth. The second from McLaren Flat is off the vineyard surrounding the winery, producing elegant lifted wines with fine tannins. The third from Blewitt Springs  produces wines with elegant red fruits and hints of menthol. And the last vineyard from Aldinga produces full bodied wines with dark fruits. The resultant blend is one of exquisite balance, far surpassing the sum of its' parts.

DESCRIPTION_KR: Company name:Lumiere Co., Ltd.(株式会社ルミエール); Created in 1967 by Lumière’s fourth-generation winemaker, Tsukamoto, “Château Lumière” was Japan’s first serious attempt at crafting a blended red wine using only domestically grown grapes. For over 58 years, it has remained our flagship wine. As the first Japanese wine to win a gold medal at an international competition, it played a pivotal role in showcasing the quality and technical excellence of Japanese winemaking to the world. Rich and full-bodied, yet marked by the soft tannins unique to Japan’s terroir, it offers a gentle, balanced taste—never too heavy or astringent—making it an ideal match for Japanese cuisine. Loved by wine enthusiasts both in Japan and abroad, it continues to earn consistent acclaim from international visitors across Europe, the Americas, and Asia. <Gold Medal – Sakura Japan Women's Wine Awards 2025>

DESCRIPTION_KR: Since 1818, Heering Cherry Liqueur has been a fashion accessory, adding extravagance and civilization to the mix of some of the most legendary cocktails of all time, including the original Singapore Sling. This Heering Cherry Liqueur contains only natural ingredients including Danish grown cherries, no additives or artificial colorings. Heering Cherry Liqueur is the original "Cherry Brandy"-the legendary Singapore Sling. In 1819, Sir Thomas Stamford Raffles landed in Singapore and purchased a plot of land from the Sultan of Johor where he created a trading post for the British East Asian Trading Company. A hundred years later, in the lobby bar of the infamous Raffles Hotel, legendary bartender Mr Ngiam Tong Boon concocted the very first cocktail to achieve global fame by mixing 30ml gin, 15ml Heering Cherry Liqueur, 120ml pineapple juice, 15ml lime juice, 7.5ml Cointreau, 7.5ml Dom Benedictine, 10ml Grenadine and a dash of Angostura Bitters, which was shaken but not stirred, served on ice in a cocktail glass. By contributing to the legendary Singapore Sling, Heering Cherry Liqueur learned an important lesson-it is rather fulfilling to be part of a greater whole.

DESCRIPTION_KR: Güertana is our most distinctive white wine, made from 100% Sauvignon Blanc and aged for 2 months on its fine lees. This process enhances the grape’s natural elegance, adding volume and complexity to the palate. Güertana delivers a Mediterranean expression of Sauvignon Blanc — fresh, balanced, and uniquely characterful — combining subtle herbal notes with hints of stone fruit and tropical aromas.; VITICULTURE:; • ALTITUDE: 910 m.; • SOIL: sandy with limestone components.; • AGE: 21 years old.; • CULTIVATION: trellis irrigation, medium production.; • HARVEST : early september, mechanical harvesting at night.; WINEMAKING; The grapes destined for Güertana are subjected to short maceration of just a few hours at low temperatures and after a subsequent static pressing and racking, a fermentation process takes place using selected yeasts for 21 days at around 16ºC. The wine is allowed to rest on its own lees for a duration of 2 months. Throughout this period, regular stirrings are performed, contributing to the development of a nuanced and layered aromatic profile, as well as enhancing the structural complexity of Güertana.; TASTING; Colour Straw yellow color, clean and bright, presenting itself seductive and elegant.; Nose it highlights green citrus notes such as grapefruit, exotic tropical fruits, and white flowers.; Palate expressive, ample, with good persistence and acidity, which makes it pleasant and fresh on the palate.

DESCRIPTION_KR: Güertano is our most emblematic wine, a symbol of the Murcian land and its winemaking tradition. DESCRIPTION_KR: Camelot is our most treasured creation, a sweet wine made from overripe grapes that mature naturally on the vine, each bunch capturing the purest essence of Monastrell. Production is extremely limited —no more than 8,000 bottles per year— as only the finest grapes are selected and further dried in the winery to enhance their natural sweetness. Fermentation is carefully halted to preserve the grape’s own sugar, resulting in an elegant, silky wine with a perfectly balanced sweetness that embodies the noble character of Jumilla.; VINICULTURE:; • ALTITUDE : 720 m.; • SOIL : sandy with a limestone mantle on the surface, shallow soil; • AGE: 60 years old.; • CULTIVATION : dry-farmed, bush vines with extremely low production, 0,5 Kgs per vine.; • HARVEST : late October even at the end of November, manual harvesting; WINEMAKING; Made from 100% Monastrell grapes overripe on the vine itself. This is achieved thanks to the previous harvests leaving only a part of the grapes that will give rise to our Camelot.; The grapes are macerated for about fifteen days at low temperatures, producing a fermentation stop due to the addition of alcohol. The must is obtained thanks to a low intensity pressing, and is deposited in the racking vats and then transferred to the barrels to tame its tannins.; TASTING; Colour Intense cherry color.; Nose aromas of overripe fruits such as plum, fig, and raisin, accompanied by woody terpenes thanks to its time in oak.; Palate reveals a harmonious balance between sugars and acidity, yielding a wine that is both exuberant and exquisite, leaving a long-lasting trail and a joyful memory.

DESCRIPTION_KR: The golden lid of the bottle of Freedo, the so-called "golden bell",; is where hidden the mysterious secret that the degree of the liquor can adjusted through proper rotating,; and the 38°-69° scale mark marking a circle around the bottle can be clearly seen at the upper part of the golden lid;; It contains multiple unique organs.; When one set the rotation to adjust the degree, the organs inside will follow,; and automatically and accurately, the proportions of two different degrees of wines will be calculated,; when the wine is poured, it mixes quickly and thoroughly,; so that the two wine molecules recombines and a new degree of liquor is produced.; And with this series of high-tech, you need only to turn the "golden bell",; and as magical as magic, the adjusting of degree would be completed to get a specific degree to your desire.; Rotating the "golden bell" of Freedo,; and turning the red arrow to the number corresponding to the desired degree, till a soft "click" is heard,; then there is the desired degree of the wine,; and it is just ready for drink once it is poured out.; Available degrees to get with rotation: 38°, 42°, 45°, 52°, 69° degrees,; And you can rotate left and right back and forth, switching between high and low degrees.; The second generation of Freedo is a unique "bottle in a bottle" design.; From the outside, there is only one bottle, but in fact there are two bottles integrated in one:; the inner bottle is containing with (340ml) 69-degree original blend essence, and the outer bottle (410ml) is containing with 38-degree high-quality base wine.; All together, there is a total of 750ml Wuliangye premium wine.
DESCRIPTION_EN: The golden lid of the bottle of Freedo, the so-called "golden bell",; is where hidden the mysterious secret that the degree of the liquor can adjusted through proper rotating,; and the 38°-69° scale mark marking a circle around the bottle can be clearly seen at the upper part of the golden lid;; It contains multiple unique organs.; When one set the rotation to adjust the degree, the organs inside will follow,; and automatically and accurately, the proportions of two different degrees of wines will be calculated,; when the wine is poured, it mixes quickly and thoroughly,; so that the two wine molecules recombines and a new degree of liquor is produced.; And with this series of high-tech, you need only to turn the "golden bell",; and as magical as magic, the adjusting of degree would be completed to get a specific degree to your desire.; Rotating the "golden bell" of Freedo,; and turning the red arrow to the number corresponding to the desired degree, till a soft "click" is heard,; then there is the desired degree of the wine,; and it is just ready for drink once it is poured out.; Available degrees to get with rotation: 38°, 42°, 45°, 52°, 69° degrees,; And you can rotate left and right back and forth, switching between high and low degrees.; The second generation of Freedo is a unique "bottle in a bottle" design.; From the outside, there is only one bottle, but in fact there are two bottles integrated in one:; the inner bottle is containing with (340ml) 69-degree original blend essence, and the outer bottle (410ml) is containing with 38-degree high-quality base wine.; All together, there is a total of 750ml Wuliangye premium wine.

DESCRIPTION_KR: Gastrodia is harvested from the "imitation wild planting base" under the natural forest above 1800 meters above sea level, and no fertilizer or pesticide is used in the planting and growing process. Through the production mode of "planting and growing in wild environment" at the front end and "no chemical addition and processing" at the back end, the substitution and conversion of wild raw materials are fully realized, the "authentic quality" of Gastrodia gastrodia is guaranteed, and an "ecological product" with wild quality is formed.; Maotai Town, which has a unique geographical environment and microbial paradise, is the base wine of Maotai. Distilled from zisha shale filtered water in the upper reaches of the Chishui River, local red shell waxy-sorghum as the main material, real estate high-quality wheat composition, long-term constant temperature storage in the pottery altar, and strict "12987" ancient process carefully brewed into authentic Maotai wine.; Wolfberry from Ningxia, Ningxia wolfberry main features: wolfberry grains, full, long round, less seeds thick meat, sweet taste, sweet after taste, red color, light water, naked seeds light, easy to float in water. Spray water to moisten, knock off the skin, and then smoke it with sulfur, after drying, its white powder, called pink American ginseng. When the skin is dried or dried immediately after being dug up, it is the raw American ginseng

DESCRIPTION_KR: ORIGIN – TERROIR; Château Saint Brice is located a few kilometres from the famous town of Saint-Emilion. This family property has existed since 1932. The 13 hectares of vines are pampered, observed and cultivated with all the French know-how of the Myshkin family. The 35 year old vineyard is planted in gravelly soil, typical of the region, which offers all the splendour of this fine wine. It is subject to a reasoned protection notably thanks to practices such as the ploughing of the rows of vines, grassing, disbudding or leaf removal. Château Saint Brice gets part of its secret from green harvesting.; VINIFICATION; Harvesting at optimum maturity with an optical sorting table.; Cold pre-fermentation maceration for 4 to 6 days for optimal extraction.; Automatic pumping over and micro-oxygenation.; Hot maceration for 3 to 4 weeks depending on tasting.; Aged for 12 months - 50% in new French oak barrels and 50% in barrels.; GRAPES VARIETIES; 80% Merlot; 20% Cabernet; TASTING NOTES; With a beautiful purple and ruby colour, Château Saint Brice offers a nose with notes of blackcurrant, red fruit and a hint of vanilla and spices. The mouth is round, supple and elegant on the attack. It gradually evolves towards an assertive character and pronounced and powerful tannins. On the finish, you discover a wine with subtle roasted notes.; FOOD & WINE PAIRING; Château Saint Brice is the perfect accompaniment to noble dishes such as foie gras or duck. It will also go perfectly with cheeses of character.; Serve between 17° and 18°C.

The Hohnart produces wines with fruity aromas and a spicy minerality, often with hints of exotic fruit.

DESCRIPTION_KR: The southwestern-facing steep slope with an incline of up to 55% is the highest point in the village and is named after the old castle, the ancestral seat of the House of Castell. Documents show that the Schlossberg has been planted with vines since 1266, which are rooted in slate-gravelly gypsum keuper. The gypsum keuper here is characterized by a high alabaster content. The raw soil, with only a very thin layer of humus-rich topsoil, forces the vines in this VDP.GROSSEN LAGE to drive their roots down into the primary rock, the myophoria and estheria layers. This has a decisive influence on the wines and makes the minerality of the soil palatable. The long-lasting evening sun and favorable westerly winds ensure aromatic, balanced, and long-lasting Silvaner wines.

DESCRIPTION_KR: You won’t find many Veltliners from Znojmo with such high residual sugar on the market (if at all), but the beautifully ripe grapes prompted us to try something new…inverted label, higher residual sugar…simply Veltliner UPSIDE DOWN. Give it a chance and you will be pleasantly surprised. The color of the wine is sparkling, light greenish yellow, with a higher viscosity. The aroma is fresh, slightly spicy with a hint of lime blossom, honey and almonds. The taste is balanced, full but fresh, slightly spicy with a hint of green almonds, which are complemented by a very pleasant acidity. During maturation in the bottle, spicy peppery notes can further develop, which over time will give way to a bright almond flavor. The finish of the wine is pleasantly persistent.

DESCRIPTION_KR: Wang Zeli (1858-1931), styled Lifu, was the founder of WangMou and Ronghe Distillery. As the leader of Maotai's militia, he enjoyed great local prestige. His family's wealth began with his grandfather's salt and liquor businesses, eventually making them the wealthiest in the region. Being the only son, Wang Zeli inherited the family legacy. In 1879, he co-founded the "Rongtaihe" distillery with his family's old brewery, producing Moutai liquor (known as Wangmou). He personally managed production and sales. (Excerpt from Guizhou Provincial Annals) Wang Zeli's grandson Wang Zongde later inherited the original "Wangmou" recipe and craftsmanship to craft this "intangible cultural heritage" liquor.; "Intangible Cultural Heritage Beauty" sauce-flavored liquor,Branded new name WONGMOU, produced by China Guizhou Maotai Town Ronghe Distillery (Hong Kong) Co., Ltd., is sourced from Wang Zongde Distillery in Maotai Town, the core production area of China's liquor capital. The distillery leverages its unique natural conditions and employs the traditional sauce-flavored liquor (Kunsha) brewing technique, which has been passed down for over a century (one production cycle per year, two grain inputs, nine steams, eight fermentations, and seven distillations), to craft this exquisite liquor.

DESCRIPTION_KR: Disgorged in January 2025 with a dosage of 3.5 grams per liter, the latest release of Savart''s NV L''Ouverture is predominantly based on the 2022 vintage (60%), with the remainder from the 2021 and 2020 vintages. Crafted entirely from Pinot Noir grown in Écueil, it includes 40% purchased fruit, which Savart’s team harvests themselves. The wine is vinified in 350-, 400-, 500- and 600-liter barrels, with 5% to 10% of the barrels being new. Wafting from the glass with aromas of pear, red apple, pastries and spices, it''s medium-bodied and fruit-forward, with succulent yet vibrant acidity and an expansive finish. Among Savart’s range, this particular wine may come across as somewhat straightforward.; Published: May 08, 2025 Drink Date: 2025 - 2030

It graces the beer lists of Michelin-starred sushi restaurants across Japan.; 這款精釀啤酒採用酒米品種赤岩小町米，於木桶中發酵釀製。散發柑橘與梨子交織的果香氣息，佐以怡人酸度。由國產麥芽與米釀造的優雅風味層次，引領至餘韻悠長的滿足感。其身影遍佈日本米其林星級壽司餐廳的啤酒酒單。

DESCRIPTION_KR: PAS DOSÉ - 65% Pinot Bianco, 20% Chardonnay, 15% Sorbara Metodo Classico; "The Pinot Bianco is a dancer." This is how Andrea Razzaboni describes this wine, and we can’t help but agree. Zero sugars, zero concessions: it is a Pas Dosé in every sense. But it’s the Sorbara that adds the final touch with a burst of freshness and sapidity.

DESCRIPTION_KR: VENTIVENTI ROSÉ - 100% Lambrusco di Sorbara Metodo Classico; “If there’s one wine that represents us, it’s this one.” Ventiventi Rosé is the manifesto of the winery's style. Fresh, versatile, and gastronomic. Just 2 g/l of residual sugar is enough to create a play of acidity and savoriness that never gets tiring. DESCRIPTION_KR: ROUGE DE NOIRS - 100% Lambrusco Salamino di Santa Croce Metodo Classico; “A bubble that makes you smile. And when a bubble makes you smile, you've already won.” The Rouge de Noirs is exactly that: a smile in a glass. Its ruby red color is an explosion of vitality. On the nose, you'll find cherry, berries, and a hint of underbrush. On the palate, the magic unfolds: smoothness at the entry, with a clean and dry finish. The Rouge de Noirs is the triumph of Salamino di Santa Croce, a grape often underestimated, but here it finds its redemption through the classic method of winemaking. Dosage? 1 g/l, dry, essential, and sincere.

DESCRIPTION_KR: HAPPY SELVAGGIO - Sorbara Ancestrale; “Wild and fun.” That's what those who created it say, and there’s not much more to add. The name says it all: Happy Selvaggio is the playful side of wine. The result of an ancestral approach, it’s a sip of freedom. Its bright ruby red color and aromas of berries and wild strawberries instantly captivate you. And then there’s the choice: shake the bottle to mix the yeasts or leave it clear? Zero sugar, zero compromises .

DESCRIPTION_KR: BLANC DE BLANCS - 100% Pignoletto Metodo Classico; The Pignoletto, a sincere and straightforward grape variety, is the star of this Metodo Classico. Here, the concept of "juicy" finds its most authentic expression. After 26 months on the lees (and soon 36!), the Blanc de Blancs offers complex aromas: ripe white fruit and delicate hints of baking intertwine harmoniously. On the palate, it is creamy and persistent, with an almond note in the finish. And no, it’s not a mistake. That almond note is the distinctive signature of Pignoletto, a mark of authenticity.
